installedAcceptance.earlierFailures: Immediate attraction cancellation and repeated graph work reproduced; fixes independently reviewed and regression tested.

boundaries: Explicit metadata-only window/area selection; no automatic semantic recognition.
Presentation cache bounded at two seconds; exact record actions and context validation remain current.
Camera code preserved outside compiled source; mobile/Unity deferred.
Graphics never grant memory, learning credit, state or permissions.
Sustained complete rendering FPS and dense accessibility are unqualified.
